pages.text: Health 140, Armor 6, Toughness 1, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Attack 17, Speed 0.24.$(br)With the secrets of the Nether Scroll unravelled, you set about turning lifeless magma blocks into a golem of your own. A few attempts later, the Magma Golem was walking.
Right-click the central $(l)redstone block$() with a $(l)Vitality Core$().
A golem cast from magma, it has learned to hurl heavy, crushing fireballs, and swings its arm in melee when it must.$(br)You can use a $(item)Magma Block$() on it to heal it.
